say.en: For centuries mushrooms and bacteria were called plants. Today we know a mushroom is closer to us than to a mango tree. How did our classification change? In this lesson: Trace classification from Aristotle to Whittaker.
State the criteria of the five-kingdom system.
Recall the basic features of Plantae and Animalia.

body.en: Aristotle classified plants into trees, shrubs and herbs, and animals into those with red blood and those without. Linnaeus used two *kingdoms*, Plantae and Animalia. The two-kingdom system lumped together prokaryotes and eukaryotes, unicellular and multicellular forms, and photosynthetic and non-photosynthetic fungi, so it was not satisfactory.
body.kn: ಅರಿಸ್ಟಾಟಲ್ ಸಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಮರ, ಪೊದೆ, ಮೂಲಿಕೆ ಎಂದೂ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕೆಂಪು ರಕ್ತ ಇರುವ ಮತ್ತು ಇಲ್ಲದವು ಎಂದೂ ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿದರು. ಲಿನ್ನಿಯಸ್ ಎರಡು ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯ ಪದ್ಧತಿ ನೀಡಿದರು; ಅದು ಸಮರ್ಪಕವಾಗಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ.

body.en: R.H. Whittaker in 1969 proposed five *kingdoms*: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae and Animalia. His criteria were cell structure, body organisation, mode of nutrition, reproduction and phylogenetic relationships. Plantae are eukaryotic, chlorophyll-containing and have cellulose cell walls; Animalia are heterotrophic, multicellular eukaryotes without cell walls.

problem.en: Using Whittaker's criteria, decide the kingdom of (a) a yeast cell and (b) a bacterium.

steps.en: Yeast: eukaryotic cell, heterotrophic (absorptive), cell wall of chitin → kingdom Fungi.
Bacterium: prokaryotic cell with no nuclear membrane → kingdom Monera.
Cell structure alone already separates them: prokaryote versus eukaryote.

Cell structure alone already separates them: prokaryote versus eukaryote.

say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಅರಿಸ್ಟಾಟಲ್ ಮತ್ತು ಲಿನ್ನಿಯಸ್ ಆರಂಭಿಕ ಸರಳ ಪದ್ಧತಿಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡಿದರು.

say.en: Whittaker 1969: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae, Animalia.
say.kn: ವಿಟ್ಟೇಕರ್ 1969: ಮೊನೆರಾ, ಪ್ರೊಟಿಸ್ಟಾ, ಶಿಲೀಂಧ್ರ, ಸಸ್ಯ, ಪ್ರಾಣಿ.

say.en: Criteria: cell structure, body organisation, nutrition, reproduction, phylogeny.
say.kn: ಆಧಾರಗಳು: ಕೋಶ ರಚನೆ, ದೇಹ ಸಂಘಟನೆ, ಪೋಷಣೆ, ಸಂತಾನೋತ್ಪತ್ತಿ, ವಂಶಾವಳಿ.

say.en: Next: Kingdom Monera.
